h: Orji Uzor Kalu says Tinubu has done well on the macroeconomy but Nigerians are still struggling
p: Former Senate Chief Whip Orji Uzor Kalu has credited President Tinubu with progress on the macroeconomy while admitting that many Nigerians are still struggling with the cost of living.
more: Kalu is a member of the ruling APC.
The APC has said previous governments also failed to end poverty.
